reviews.text: A fun game that gets more and more challenging the farther you get. Play a small cursed knight trying to get through various traps and dangers all in the name of saving the princess! The main running joke is a bit immature if you can't stand fart jokes you should steer clear of this. Easy to understand controls and a challenge worth checking out! You can see my entire review here: https://youtu.be/AAYuzkQ6qcE

Venturing into the unknown, battling bitter conditions, enduring months of complete darkness, constant danger, and uncertain safe returns – players are needed for the ultimate test. What awaits you in this game is not just a simple journey, but a pinnacle of challenges. The management of this game is straightforward, ensuring that players can quickly grasp the mechanics and jump right into the action. However, don't be deceived by its simplicity, as this game offers an unparalleled level of challenge. The sense of immersion is remarkable; you'll find yourself fully engrossed in a world full of perils and uncertainties. Every decision holds weight, as your survival depends on your ability to adapt and overcome the numerous dangers lurking in the shadows. Months of complete darkness present a unique twist, forcing players to rely on their instincts and resourcefulness. It's a constant battle against the unknown, and only the bravest and most resilient will emerge victorious.

[h1]“屁滚屎流”的铁甲骑士拯救公主！[/h1] 《Potty Knight Saga》是由PLAY Mephistowaltz自研自发的一款3D横板动作冒险游戏，游戏用相当不错的卡通画风构筑了一个“屁滚屎流”的铁甲骑士！别奇怪，因为真的是“屁滚屎流”，冒险途中，我们可爱的铁甲骑士时不时就要停下放个屁，没血了还会一路拉屎的继续向前，真的是闻者发臭，看者恶心！ 游戏的场景构筑相当不错，立体横版的模式虽然会让玩家在闯关的时候增加许多难度，但也让游戏多了更多的趣味性，比如陷阱的构筑就更多样化了，如果是平面横版，一些陷阱就是直观的闯过就行，但采用了立体横版，兴许我们还能换个角度跳过去！ 玩法上主要就是闯关，攻击和技能属于近乎没存在感的设置，因为这一路上敌人很少，而且强度很低，偶尔有那么几个也是可以用拉扯的方法轻松干掉。主要还是路上的各种陷阱对玩家颇有挑战，加上主角铁甲骑士时不时还要停下来放个屁，经常让玩家精心设想的闯关节奏突然受挫，但是看着那么可爱的小铁人，还真是有点生气不起来。 游戏难度其实并不高，但是多少还是有点搞心态的，比如时不时放个屁，残血走路满地屎，还是时不时没任何征兆突然就下掉的地板，这些应该都是恶趣味的一种，对于吾等不苟言笑的正直人士来说，哪怕主角是一位可爱的卡通铁甲骑士都无法弥补这一点搞心态的恶趣味！ 整体而言，游戏还算是一款较为不错的平台闯关游戏，画面和关卡设计是其最大的优点，至于其他，仁者见仁智者见智吧！ [quote]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家:[url= https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402982/]走心评测[/url] ←遵从内心，写出真实感受 欢迎加入我们Steam组:[url= https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ZXPC]走心评测[/url]←点击加入，一起探索游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到！[/quote]

[h2]POSITIVE POINTS:[/h2] - Potty Knight Saga is characterized by having a good level design, and many traps, which will undoubtedly test your skill. - First of all, it is a game with a very accessible gameplay, but at the same time very difficult to master due to the random "farting" mechanics of the character. - It's a lot of fun, and has situations that will definitely make you let out a smile or a laugh. - It has some very cute and funny animated scenes. - If you pass the game, you will have the honor of feeling like a real gentleman. [h2]NEGATIVE POINTS:[/h2] - Many cheats require trial and error, which will not please all players. - Just like farting doesn't appeal to everyone... - ...especially when you fart and make the brave knight die. [h2]CONCLUSIONS:[/h2] Potty Knight Saga is a challenging and fun platform game that knows how to play with surprises and the uncertainty of the traps in its scenarios. But above all, it is a very fun game, and original: cursing by throwing the controller and laughing have never been so close at hand. [h2]EVALUATION: [/h2] 8/10. Despite its somewhat unfair difficulty at times, the game offers a very engaging and unique experience in its concept. Put another way, Potty Knight Saga is a challenge worth taking on for those looking for an exciting and rewarding adventure. If you like platformers and fun, you can't miss it. [h1]超。沙雕风骑士冒险传奇，哭着笑着救公主[/h1] 这是一款2.5D横板冒险类轻度动作游戏，上手及其简单但是通关过程绝对会让你哭笑不得！故事的开局，主人公小骑士被小船带向了一座孤岛，似乎主人公的运气“不大好”，在被风暴“强行”送至岛屿后，起身所见只有郁郁葱葱的森林和一座高塔，这时郁闷的骑士回忆起了他的经历：为了治愈身上的“腹泻”诅咒，不得不过来冒险拯救公主！ [h1]奇葩角色设定，苦痛关卡体验，闻着臭吃着香[/h1] 绝对随机的腹泻设定是本作的特色所在，不得不品的仙品设计，很难有游戏在这么可爱的画风下打造这么有趣的设定，还造出了一系列难度系数极高的关卡！ [h1] “当马里奥MEETS黑暗之魂“，并非等闲之辈[/h1] 假如是《喵里奥》是作者通过纯粹的关卡设计赋予了游戏“来骗，来偷袭”的游戏闯关思路和通关技巧，那我在这里可以自豪的告诉你，本作没有什么技巧，只有跳跳乐＋轻松打怪，但是随时随地诅咒发作，放出臭屁的排泄会硬控玩家数秒，这数秒的悬空和随机设定会让你哭笑不得，让关卡处处妙趣横生！毕竟这只是一个学会跳跳乐和挥动🗡即可畅玩的游戏，你可以在尖刺/火焰机关上拉臭臭然后被强控吃伤害，或者在悬空处窜出来然后落入虚空重头来过，笔者不得不说这个游戏过于荒谬的有意思了，尤其是带上你的小伙伴一同游玩，互相见证血槽清空时拉出一地黄色胶体物（憋笑），非常有节目效果和味道。 [h1]结语[/h1] 超好笑的骑士冒险传说，趣味性拉满，但是注意3条命用完了就只能重新来过了，请在一遍遍尝试中挑战自己吧！ [quote] 奏游戏之乐章，品人生之绚烂 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45672460/]欢迎加入 『 丰川集团 』[/url] [u][b]以丰川集团之名，行评测鉴赏之事[/b][/u][/quote]

Potty Knight Saga, developed and published by PLAY Mephistowaltz, is a deceptively simple action-platformer that hides a surprisingly demanding core beneath its colorful, humorous presentation. At first glance, it appears lighthearted and even a bit silly, with its playful aesthetic and unconventional premise, but once you begin navigating its levels, it becomes clear that the game is built around precision, timing, and persistence. It occupies that familiar space where approachable mechanics meet unforgiving design, creating an experience that can be both charming and punishing depending on the player’s tolerance for challenge. The gameplay is centered on tight, obstacle-heavy stages that require careful movement and exact execution. Controls are straightforward—jumping, moving, and interacting with the environment—but the simplicity of these inputs is contrasted by the difficulty of their application. Every section is designed to test your ability to react quickly and plan movements with precision, often leaving little room for error. Traps are placed deliberately, enemy positioning is calculated, and progression through each level demands a clear understanding of patterns and timing. Failure is frequent, and the game expects players to learn through repetition, gradually refining their approach until they succeed. Level design is where the game finds its strongest footing. Each stage feels carefully constructed, with obstacles arranged to challenge both reflexes and awareness. Rather than overwhelming players with complexity, the game builds its difficulty through the interaction of simple elements, combining them in ways that require increasing levels of mastery. As you progress, the challenges become more intricate, often requiring a combination of precise jumps, quick reactions, and an understanding of how different hazards interact. This creates a sense of growth, not through upgrades or new abilities, but through the player’s own improvement. Combat is present but plays a secondary role to platforming. Enemies act more as extensions of the environment than as focal points of gameplay, requiring players to incorporate attacks into their movement rather than engage in prolonged fights. While this integration helps maintain the pacing and keeps the focus on traversal, the combat mechanics themselves are fairly basic and do not evolve significantly. As a result, they serve their purpose without adding much depth to the overall experience. The game’s visual style is bright and stylized, leaning into a playful aesthetic that contrasts sharply with its difficulty. Environments are colorful and varied enough to remain visually engaging, even when players are forced to repeat sections multiple times. Character designs and animations contribute to the game’s quirky personality, reinforcing its lighthearted tone. While the graphics are not technically advanced, the art direction is consistent and effective, giving the game a distinct identity that sets it apart from more visually subdued platformers. Tone plays an important role in shaping the experience. Potty Knight Saga embraces a sense of humor that feels intentionally absurd, using its premise and presentation to create a contrast with its demanding gameplay. This juxtaposition can make the experience feel more approachable, softening the frustration that comes with repeated failure. At the same time, the humor does not interfere with the mechanics, allowing the game to maintain its focus on challenge and precision. Pacing is heavily influenced by the game’s difficulty curve. Early stages provide a manageable introduction, but the challenge ramps up quickly, requiring players to adapt and improve. Progress can be slow, particularly in later levels where mistakes are punished more severely. This can lead to moments of frustration, especially for players who are not accustomed to precision-based platformers. However, for those who enjoy overcoming difficult challenges, the sense of accomplishment that comes with completing a tough section is one of the game’s most rewarding aspects. In terms of content, the game remains focused on its core experience. It does not offer a wide range of modes or extensive systems, instead relying on its level design to provide engagement. Replay value comes primarily from mastering levels, improving performance, and pushing through increasingly difficult challenges. This focus keeps the experience cohesive, but it also means that players looking for variety or additional features may find it limited. There are some drawbacks to this approach. The high level of difficulty can be a barrier for more casual players, and the reliance on repetition can make certain sections feel more frustrating than enjoyable. Additionally, while the mechanics are solid, they do not expand significantly over time, which can lead to a sense of familiarity in later stages. Minor technical or design issues may also occasionally disrupt the flow, though they are not the defining aspect of the experience. Ultimately, Potty Knight Saga succeeds in delivering a focused and challenging platformer that knows exactly what it wants to be. It combines simple controls with demanding level design, creating a gameplay loop that rewards patience and skill. Its quirky presentation adds personality without detracting from its core mechanics, resulting in a game that is both distinctive and engaging for the right audience. In the end, it is best suited for players who appreciate precision platforming and are willing to embrace a trial-and-error approach. While it may not appeal to everyone, those who enjoy overcoming difficult challenges will find a satisfying and memorable experience within its deceptively playful world. Rating: 8/10
